Name: Tearoppai's Random Critters
Author: tearoppai
Description:
Threw this together real quick because the valley felt too lifeless in the way of bugs. It consists of two different types of flies, ladybugs and dragonflies.

This mod requires SMAPI and Spacechase's Custom Critters to run. When you've installed those correctly, drag the tearoppai.bugs folder into Mods > CustomCritters > Critters
